name: uni
tagline: The native academic workspace for macOS

label: Values
paragraphs: uni is the native academic workspace for macOS, engineered to solve the chronic fragmentation of higher education portals by unifying class timetables, faculty notices, deadlines, and GPA projections into a single fast, distraction-free command center.

built on an uncompromising local-first and zero-cloud architecture, all data stays strictly on your device: featuring intelligent 24h iCal timetable normalization that parses messy university feeds, a low-overhead AppleScript bridge for Microsoft Outlook, and zero-copy Finder links so your study materials remain untouched in their original folders.

label: Dashboard
subtitle: Today's schedule, deadlines & notices
caption: Unified daily overview highlighting today's scheduled lectures, imminent assignment deadlines, and linked teacher communications.

label: Intelligent Calendar
subtitle: 24h timetable & iCal webcal parsing
caption: Automated calendar normalization that turns raw university feeds into clear lecture blocks, assigned rooms, and faculty references.

label: Deadlines & Deliveries
subtitle: In-app solid HUD & focus sessions
caption: Delivery tracking with non-intrusive floating pill HUD alerts and built-in Pomodoro focus sessions for deep study blocks.

label: Exams & Career
subtitle: Weighted GPA & graduation baseline
caption: Comprehensive academic transcript tracking: arithmetic & weighted GPA, CFU progress, and real-time graduation score projections.

label: Spotlight Palette (⌘F)
subtitle: Instant keyboard search across all courses
caption: Command palette invoked anywhere via ⌘F to instantly locate courses, lecture materials, exam dates, or launch context actions.

label: macOS Distribution
subtitle: Custom drag-and-drop installer
caption: Custom-crafted DMG installer with branded background and seamless drag-and-drop installation into Applications.
